summary: Frontend-only verification of the new DOWNLOAD/EXPORT feature batch (Tasks 1-4). All 12 download buttons trigger valid download events with correct file extensions and Spanish filenames. All target pages load without runtime pageerrors. Initial failures on 2 buttons were transient (previous modal not fully unmounted before next open); after clean navigation both pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (unrelated) React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in ThesisSidebar select (line ~297). Still present and noisy in console on /thesis navigations. Non-blocking but worth cleaning up.
Filename for page-export-pdf ('valuation-studio-valuation-studio-equity-research.pdf') is duplicated; consider deriving from the actual page title/route for better UX when saving multiple pages.
When multiple chart modals share Escape-to-close, closing one before opening the next has a brief unmount race; not user-facing but worth using a single modal manager if more modals are added.
test_credentials: localStorage 'vs:token' = 'test_profile_token_fixed_123' (test_profile_user_123, profiletest@example.com). Set AFTER first navigation then reload.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded thesis_test_aidc and NVDA kpi_snapshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All export/download buttons work: thesis PDF/DOCX, KPI PDF/DOCX, visual JPG, macro trend+coef-history JPGs, company chart JPG + ratio-history JPG, treemap JPG (html2canvas), and header page-to-PDF (html2pdf). Use page.expect_download and assert suggested_filename. Note: opening a chart modal after Escape-closing another sometimes needs a clean page.goto() to reset state — first run had 2 false negatives that all passed on retry with fresh navigation.
